title: Emergency Food Storage
description: Covers calculating how much food to store, long-, medium-, and short-term categories, and building a balanced pantry. Explains food-grade containers, Mylar bags, and oxygen absorbers, storage conditions, FIFO rotation, a sample one-week pantry, special diets, budget building, and common mistakes.
shortDescription: How much to store, what lasts, Mylar and oxygen absorbers, and rotation
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
